page.title: Human Design — Knowledge Base
page.introAdmin: Three separate interpretation sources: Central Knowledge Base Interpretation (all central records including drafts; editing and bulk content deletion), My Expert Notes (your own personal records) and the chart-bound System Interpretation.
page.introExpert: Manage your type, authority, profile, definition, center, channel, gate and strategy interpretations. Active records are matched automatically with the client chart on the Create Report screen.
page.expertNote: Your own personal Knowledge Base (the same workspace as regular experts). It is not merged with central content; it is used as "{label}" in analyses and Word.
page.systemNote: This interpretation is saved when a chart is calculated with our calculation infrastructure and is shown only on that chart's screen. It is not an editable library; viewing it does not create a new calculation request. It is not shown for charts without a saved interpretation.
page.goAnalyses: Go to My Human Design Analyses →
page.emptyKind: No identities found for this kind.

page.bulkKeep: Canonical identity records will not be deleted.
